sujet: Balades où les enfants traînent des pieds (9)

scenes.prompt: A Sunday family walk on a country path near an Alsatian village: the two parents walk far ahead on the right and turn around smiling, while two children aged 7 and 9 stay far behind on the left, one sits sulking on a big stone with arms crossed, the other drags his feet with a long bored face, autumn trees, half-timbered houses in the distance. Nobody holds the children.

On a forest path, a child aged 8 sits on the ground holding his foot with a dramatic face while his sister aged 9 hangs on a parent's arm, the French parent carries a backpack and laughs tiredly, an Alsatian village with half-timbered houses far in the distance, autumn leaves.

Children aged 7 to 10 dressed as little knights with cardboard armor, golden paper crowns and a helmet with a red plume run ahead full of energy on a sunny cobbled Alsatian lane with half-timbered houses, one waving a rolled treasure map, the surprised parents smile far behind.

Children aged 7 to 10 dressed as knights with crowns and a red plumed helmet hurry ahead on a cobbled Alsatian lane, one points with a magnifying glass at a small hidden wooden token in an old stone wall, the parents far behind try to keep up, geranium flower boxes, plain walls, no inscriptions.

A joyful group of cousins and friends aged 7 to 10 dressed as knights with crowns and red plumed helmets march energetically in a row along a vineyard path above an Alsatian village with half-timbered houses, sunny autumn colors.
